'''Barquin D'an''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] member of the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] who played the [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]]. He was the older brother of [[Figrin D'an/Legends|Figrin D'an]], leader of the [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]]. He was also a gambler.

==Biography==
[[File:DodaBodonawieedoBarquinDan-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|250px|Bodonawieedo and Barquin D'an performing "Jedi Rocks"]]
Barquin D'an was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]]<ref name="DB" /> and [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Barquin D'an}}</ref> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="DB" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]<ref name="DB" /> who was the<ref name="Trilogy" /> estranged<ref name="DB" /> older brother of [[Figrin D'an/Legends|Figrin D'an]], another Bith musician. Barquin taught his brother the rudimentary elements of [[Music/Legends|music]], and even though his music never caught on, he had minor successes opening for [[Red Shift Limit/Legends|Red Shift Limit]], [[Starburst]], and [[Annadale Fayde]] in the [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel]], [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak]], and [[Quence sector/Legends|Quence]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. He grew bitter over Figrin, the leader of the band [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]], gaining success.<ref name="Trilogy" />

At some point, Barquin saved up his [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="DB" /> and traveled to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] seeking to get his brothers help in recording a new<ref name="Trilogy" /> demo,<ref name="WW" /> hoping that Figrin's skill would get him to the top of the intergalactic music scene. Unfortunately for Barquin, the Modal Nodes could not make the recording session<ref name="Trilogy" /> as they had left Tatooine for a three-month tour. Impoverished and stranded,<ref name="WW" /> the musician spent his remaining money getting passage to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Trilogy">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>

The atmosphere wasn't his taste at all and instead of earning money for performing with the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]], he was enslaved by the Hutt crimelord. Without any possibility to escape, he tried to find a way to kill himself. His opportunity came, when Jabba left his palace with the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] to feed [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his companions to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. Barquin waited for an opportunity to jump into the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc's]] maw, but when the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|skirmish]] broke out, he escaped into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. He headed towards [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and hid on a cargo barge to [[Stenos/Legends|Stenos]]. There, he built up an import/export business and became quite successful with it.<ref name="WW" />

==Skills and abilities==
D'an's songwriting skills were considered excellent, though his singing and playing were considered unsophisticated.<ref name="Trilogy" /> Musically, he was less skilled than his brother,<ref name="WW" /> who was superior at playing the [[Kloo horn/Legends|Kloo horn]] compared to him.<ref name="CCG" />

==Equipment==
The Bith musician used a Kloo horn and recording equipment in his music.<ref name="Trilogy" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barquin was added to the extended musical number in the ''Special Edition'' of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']]. He is portrayed by an uncredited [[Don Bies]].<ref name="Derek-Reel">{{YouTube|video=wWhNJVwJ-tM|text=Talking Sci-Fi Stuff! Welcome Don Bies! ILM FX Guy who's an actual Boba Fett &#124; Sci-Fi Zone|name=Sci-Fi Zone|channel=@scifizone|date=2024-08-22}}</ref>
